body:
**[comments] Rule 4, comment lines that map to no code line: shorten**

Every sentence maps to code that already says it: the `live |=` line (1963), the dotter loop (1965-1969) and the qk_group call (1972-1979), and the 16-head passes belong to qk_group's own comment in k_vnni.hpp (Rule 5). One line keeps the structure fact that the VNNI scores are computed after the loop, which is the one thing a reader needs before the two branches.

Proposed:
```cpp
        // Row-major K is scored in the loop. VNNI K is scored after the loop, for
        // the tokens the loop marks in `live`.
```
